errors.evidence: The description identifies the lowest value as being in the year 2000. However, the chart shows a labeled value of 58.7 for the year 2019, which is visibly the lowest point in the chart.
The description incorrectly associates the value 58.7 with the year 2018. The chart explicitly labels the value 58.7 for the year 2019.
The description incorrectly associates the value 62.9 with the year 2022. The chart explicitly labels the value 62.9 for the year 2023.
The description omits the presence of a horizontal black reference line at the 60 unit mark on the y-axis.
The description does not mention that the bars for the years 2023 and 2024 are a lighter shade of blue, which distinguishes them from the other bars and may indicate that they are projected values.
